rationale: Price is now within $0.03 of the original take-profit ($6.38) and effectively at HOD resistance ($6.39), with the last four candles showing sharply decelerating volume (58k → 50k → 35k → 16k), signaling exhausting buying pressure at a key supply level. The original thesis has largely played out, and holding for the final few cents exposes the position to a reversal off HOD with no new catalyst to drive a breakout. Closing here captures ~83% of the targeted move while avoiding a potential mean-reversion back toward the 9-EMA.
